note: Ramp, corporate cards and spend management. 8VC is named as a NEW backer in the April-2024 $150M round at $7.65B, alongside Sequoia and Greylock; Ramp's 2019 seed and 2020 rounds do not name 8VC. Golden-set row.

RelateIQ, relationship-intelligence CRM; acq. by Salesforce, July 2014, ~$390M — a YEAR BEFORE 8VC existed. Present only in the 2016 capture of 8vc.com/companies and gone from the live site. The sharpest Delta A row after Palantir: no 8VC vehicle can have held it.
Reserv, AI-assisted insurance claims adjusting, founded 2022. First listed 2023; raised a $20M Series A in 2023.
National Resilience, biomanufacturing, launched 2020 with a large founding round and raised over $2B. 8VC listed from 2021. A $1B+ mark is very likely but takes a cited priced event (Rule A).
Ritten, EHR for behavioural-health providers. First listed 2022.
Rocketlane, customer-onboarding software, founded in Chennai with a US presence. 8VC announced the partnership 2022-01-20, around the $18M Series A; the firm was in from the 2021 seed.
Saris AI, announced by 8VC 2026-05-28. First listed 2026.

Saronic Technologies, autonomous naval vessels, Austin TX, inc. 2022 — an 8VC BUILD company, which the vehicle names say outright (8VC Build Saronic SPV filed 2024-07-03, SPV II and II-A 2025-02-27). 8VC listed it from 2022, the year it was founded, so the entry precedes the first Form D by two years; the band read the 2024q3 $178.5M filing as Growth. The $600M Series C (2025) and $1.75B round (2026q2) put a $1B+ mark within reach, but that takes a cited priced event. Golden-set trap row for the Menlo inversion.
Sequence Holdings, first listed 2026; no filing or press trace on this row.
Sesh, first listed 2026, unrecognised, no filing or press trace.

Showroom, Los Angeles, inc. 2015. Jake Medwell on the single 2016q3 $6.4M seed filing inside tenure; no later round and no trace of activity. Archive-only row (2017 capture) — a survivorship recovery.
Sila Nanotechnologies, silicon anode battery materials. 8VC listed from 2022, after the 2021 $590M round at $3.3B; that mark is four years old and is re-checked rather than banded here.
Sirona Medical, cloud-native radiology software, inc. 2018. Francisco Gimenez on the 2020q1 $13.5M filing inside tenure; era-2020 A ceiling $30M.
Socotra, cloud insurance core platform; acq. by Salesforce, 2024. 8VC listed from 2020 and its CEO Dan Woods appears on the firm's 2016 advisors page, so the relationship predates the listing.

Listed as 'Software' (the archive also carries 'software-com'), i.e. Software.com, the developer-analytics company behind WakaTime-style code metrics. The bare-word name does not resolve with confidence and the row is flagged for the identity pass.
Sonoma Biotherapeutics, regulatory T-cell therapies. First listed 2022; raised a $265M Series B in 2021.
Spotnana, travel-as-a-service infrastructure. First listed 2022; raised a $75M Series C in 2022.
Stack Health, first listed 2026; no filing or press trace on this row.

Standard Metrics (formerly Quaestor — the same team's successor product), portfolio reporting for venture funds. First listed 2022; the archive also carries the Quaestor row, and the pair is examined at the identity step.
Structify, agents that build structured datasets from unstructured sources. First listed 2026.

Synthego, synthetic RNA and CRISPR kits, Redwood City CA, inc. 2012. Drew Oetting on the 2017q1 $40.7M filing inside tenure — an entry at Series B/C scale. Archive-only row (2017 capture) — a survivorship recovery.
TAP, listed 2023; a three-letter name with many candidates and no filing or press trace on this row.

Tasca Therapeutics, covalent cancer drug discovery, Cambridge MA, inc. 2021. Seth Lieblich on the 2025q4 $70.2M filing inside tenure; 8VC listed it from 2025, so the position may predate that filing and the band is a ceiling.
Terminal, remote engineering-team building; announced by 8VC 2017-10-16 as a company it helped start — a Build-shaped position.
Terminal Logistics, listed 2023 under Logistics — a distinct row from 'terminal' (the 2017 remote-engineering company), though the names collide. Flagged for the identity pass.

Terra Industries, the subject of 8VC's 'Announcing the Terra-8VC Partnership' post of 2026-01-12. NOT the fertilizer producer Terra Industries Inc, which CF Industries bought in 2010 — a name collision worth recording.

DELIBERATE DISPUTE. The Boring Company is Elon Musk's private tunnelling company, not an acquired one; the pre-filled acquired status is wrong. It raised $675M at $5.7B in 2022 and a further round in 2025. 8VC listed it from 2022. The mark needs a cited priced event before any band above below_1b; a sibling run publishes $9.6B and the pair is aligned in the cross-investor pass.
Thorin, listed 2025 under AI; no filing or press trace on this row.
Tilda Research, clinical-trial site technology. First listed 2022.

Trackonomy Systems, printed IoT sensor tape, Santa Clara CA, inc. 2017. Jake Medwell on both 2019q4 filings inside tenure ($10.4M and $41.0M). Reported unicorn marks are vendor figures; no band above below_1b without a priced event (Rule A).

Tradewing, community software for professional associations, inc. 2019. Alex Kolicich on the single 2020q2 $7.1M seed filing inside tenure; no later round and no trace of activity. Archive-only row (2022 capture) — a survivorship recovery.

Tul, Colombian construction-materials B2B marketplace, inc. 2019. Jake Medwell on the 2022q1 $127.2M filing (the Series B). The firm's own May-2022 post names both a Series A and a Series B; the filing dates the 8VC position to the Series B.

'It has been an absolute pleasure working with the Twingate team since day one when we co-led their seed and Series A rounds' — 8VC, 2022-04-14, in a post ANNOUNCING the $42M Series B led by BOND. The Menlo pattern: title names the later round, body names the entry. Golden-set row.

Unlearn.AI, digital twins for clinical trials, inc. 2017. Francisco Gimenez on the 2020q2 $12.0M Series A filing inside tenure, which the firm's own May-2020 post announces. Golden-set row; the band agreed.

DELIBERATE DISPUTE and the run's cleanest seat-dating case. The band picked the 2018q3 $11.8M filing as 8VC's entry because BHASKAR GHOSH is on it — but 8vc.com rendered Ghosh as an ADVISOR in 2016-2018 (VP Engineering and Operations, NerdWallet) and as a team member only from 2019, so that seat was not 8VC's money. The first in-tenure filing is the 2020q4 $28.0M Series B, which the firm's own November-2020 post announces ('8VC's participation in Ushur's $25M Series B, led by Third Point Ventures'). Entry is Growth. Golden-set row and a scored band miss.
Vals AI, independent evaluation of AI models. Announced by 8VC 2026-08-13, the most recent announcement in the archive.

Vector, freight-document and workflow software listed by 8VC under Logistics from 2019; acquired. A common name — a sibling run carries a Vector row acquired/below_1b, which is consistent, but the identity is worth confirming at alignment.
Vercel, the Next.js company. 8VC listed from 2022, after the 2021 $150M Series D at $2.5B; the $9.3B pre-fill is the 2025 Series F mark and is confirmed with a citation in the A/B pass.
Waabi, autonomous trucking founded 2021 by Raquel Urtasun in Toronto. 8VC listed from 2023, after the 2022 $200M Series B.

Wish / ContextLogic (NASDAQ: LOGC after the 2024 sale of the Wish marketplace to Qoo10; the listed shell continues). 8VC's own post: 'we co-led the angel round in 2010, led the Series A in 2012, bridged the company after the A and co-led the Series B'. The 2010 angel round predates Formation 8 (2011) and 8VC (2015) — this is Lonsdale's personal money, and 8VC GP I's 13F-HRs do not report ContextLogic. Delta A class, and the sharpest instance of it. Golden-set row.
WithCoverage, insurance distribution. First listed 2026.
Worktrace AI, first listed 2026; no filing or press trace on this row.

YugabyteDB, distributed SQL. '8VC led Yugabyte's oversubscribed Series B earlier this year' — the firm's own post, dated September 2020. Series B is Growth. The $1.3B pre-fill is the 2021 Series C mark and is re-checked in the A/B pass. Golden-set row.
Zanbato, private-securities trading infrastructure (ZX Network), founded 2010. First listed 2023, long after the company's early rounds.

Zenreach, WiFi-based customer marketing for physical retail, San Francisco. Joe Lonsdale on the 2017q1 $30.0M and 2018q3 $25.0M filings inside tenure, so an 8VC-era position — but the row is on 8vc.com's FIRST 2016 capture, which predates both, so the original entry sits in the Formation 8 era. Archive-only row now. Delta A class with 8VC fund evidence on top: a member under the recommended ruling.
